description: Corrected domain-mapping figure for pathogenic vs benign GATAD2B missense variants
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

L=593; CR1=(165,195); CR2=(340,480); ZNF=(414,467); CC1=(140,194); CC2=(449,482)
plp_mis=[180,316,406,414,420,441,482]
plp_tr=[24,67,77,116,122,163,174,179,192,219,220,232,237,243,274,299,325,348,349,359,411,470,471,472,473,476,477,478,480,482,490,495,500,505,510,513]
ben_mis=[50,112,180,260,345,455,520,560]   # 2 of 8 in CR1/CR2 per ClinVar tabulation

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5,5.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,-0.20),L,0.40,facecolor="#E3E6EA",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((CC2[0],-0.20),CC2[1]-CC2[0],0.40,facecolor="#F5D9B0",edgecolor="none"))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((CR1[0],-0.20),CR1[1]-CR1[0],0.40,facecolor="#4C72B0",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((CR2[0],-0.20),CR2[1]-CR2[0],0.40,facecolor="#DD8452",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((ZNF[0],-0.12),ZNF[1]-ZNF[0],0.24,facecolor="#55A868",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6))
ax.text(np.mean(CR1),-0.33,"CR1 165-195\nbinds MBD2 / MBD3",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8.5,color="#2F4B7C")
ax.text(np.mean(CR2),-0.33,"CR2 340-480: histone-tail binding, CHD3 / CHD4 recruitment",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8.5,color="#9C4A1A")
ax.text(np.mean(ZNF),0.27,"GATA-type Zn finger 414-467",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2F6B47")
ax.text(CC2[1]+6,-0.02,"coiled coil\n449-482",fontsize=7.5,color="#8A6A3A",va="center")

for p in plp_tr:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.20,0.80],c="#B5B5B5",lw=0.6,zorder=1); ax.plot(p,0.80,"o",ms=3.5,c="#8C8C8C",zorder=2)
for p in ben_mis:
    ax.plot([p,p],[-0.20,-0.80],c="#D3D9CC",lw=0.6,zorder=1); ax.plot(p,-0.80,"o",ms=4,c="#9FB08A",zorder=2)
for p in plp_mis:
    inside = CR1[0]<=p<=CR1[1] or CR2[0]<=p<=CR2[1]
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.20,1.45],c="#C44E52" if inside else "#E0A0A2",lw=1.7,zorder=3)
    ax.plot(p,1.45,"o",ms=9,c="#C44E52" if inside else "white",mec="#C44E52",mew=1.6,zorder=4)
    ax.annotate(str(p),(p,1.54),ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#C44E52",fontweight="bold")

ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#C44E52",ms=8,label="P/LP missense inside CR1 or CR2 (5)")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="white",mec="#C44E52",mew=1.6,ms=8,label="P/LP missense outside (2: p.316, p.482)")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#8C8C8C",ms=5,label="P/LP nonsense / frameshift (36 mapped)")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#9FB08A",ms=5,label="Benign / likely benign missense (8)")
ax.set_xlim(-12,L+45); ax.set_ylim(-1.25,2.0); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("p66-beta amino acid position (UniProt Q8WXI9, 593 aa)")
ax.set_title("Pathogenic GATAD2B missense variants concentrate in the NuRD-interaction domains CR1 and CR2\n"
             "5/7 (71%) vs 29% of the protein by length, binomial p = 0.025; vs 21% of 257 missense VUS, Fisher OR 9.4, p = 0.007")
ax.legend(loc="upper left",frameon=False,fontsize=8.8)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("P/LP missense in CR1/CR2: 5/7 = 71.4% (binomial vs 29.0% expected, p=0.0249)")
print("P/LP missense vs VUS missense (54/257=21.0%): Fisher OR=9.4, p=0.00698")
print("Outliers: p.316 (between CR1 and CR2), p.482 (within coiled coil 449-482, 2 aa past annotated CR2 end)")
